redFlags.description: The deck states or implies valuation without explaining basis, comparable logic, ownership, or scenario assumptions.
redFlags.fix: Request valuation basis or remove valuation language from the deck version.

redFlags.description: Public-company multiples are applied to a company without comparable scale, margin profile, growth, or revenue quality.
redFlags.fix: Label comps as directional only and explain differences.

redFlags.description: The return case ignores investor ownership, dilution, exit timing, or exit multiple assumptions.
redFlags.fix: Request ownership and dilution assumptions before presenting fund-return logic.

redFlags.description: Valuation depends on projections that are not supported by traction, pipeline, or unit economics.
redFlags.fix: Flag the projection as an assumption and request evidence supporting the revenue ramp.

safeWording: The deck does not provide enough support for this valuation claim.
Treat valuation and return case as scenario analysis until evidence is provided.
Separate current evidence from upside case.
